newsitem.title: USA: American Bankers exits two product lines.
newsitem.headline: American Bankers exits two product lines.

text.p: Excess Risk Underwriters said it has agreed to take over the marketing and administrative responsibilities for the group life and group disability products of American Bankers Insurance Group Inc.
Those products had represented about $20 million in annual premiums for American Bankers, Excess Risk said.

These two product lines have been transferred to Excess Risk along with 11 administrative personnel previously employed by American Bankers to handle group life and group disability underwriting, claims, accounting and customer service.
Excess Risk, a Miami-based insurance marketer and administrator, said these product lines are new for it.

"Unlike traditional group insurance companies, ERU plans to market these group life and group disability products through select marketing partners in strategic areas of the United States," ERU chief executive Martin Cullen said.
